description: DEPRECATED alias for wallet_risk (/v1/wallet/risk). PAID $0.025 USDC (no free tier). Returns the same merged wallet risk check: OFAC SDN list (entity, uid, programs), US gov seized cases, exploit links with evidence tx, Base USDC address-poisoning scan, wallet labels with confidence/source/first_seen, risk_score 0-100, verdict (MALICIOUS/HIGH_RISK/WATCH/LOW_RISK/UNKNOWN), and itemized reasons. Prefer wallet_risk. Covered by pass_day ($2) / pass_month ($25) (≤$1/call).

address.description: Wallet or contract to score. Format: 0x followed by 40 hex characters. Example: 0x5227f603c1ee34ce3c06efe6477003bdfccb2f8c. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].
